name: odai-dsh-plugin
description: Profile-wide odai governance and routing bundle for DeepSeek Harness.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck:dsh && npm run build:dsh && find ../runtime/build build/bin -name '*.mjs' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check
scripts.prepare:artifact: npm run build:dsh && node ../../scripts/package-odai-artifact.mjs prepare --skill-root skills --runtime-root runtime --client-root client --client-package odai-dsh-plugin
scripts.clean:artifact: node ../../scripts/package-odai-artifact.mjs clean --skill-root skills --runtime-root runtime --client-root client --client-package odai-dsh-plugin
scripts.test: npm run verify:version && npm run build:dsh && npm --prefix ../.. exec -- tsx --test ../runtime/tests/*.test.mts ./tests/*.test.mts ../../scripts/dsh-web-rpc.test.mjs
scripts.verify:dsh: npm run build:dsh && npm --prefix ../.. exec -- tsx ./tests/verify-session-compat.mts && npm --prefix ../.. exec -- tsx ./tests/verify-dsh-load.mts
scripts.smoke:live: npm run build:dsh && npm --prefix ../.. exec -- tsx ./tests/live-routing-smoke.mts
scripts.smoke:compaction-cache: npm run build:dsh && npm --prefix ../.. exec -- tsx ./tests/live-compaction-cache-smoke.mts
